items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: Interviewer states 'Eddie Benton was there for a while... I didn't know him.' Interviewee does not claim personal interaction, only narrates when Benton 'dropped out of music'.

ctx.x: And Eddie Benton was there for a while. Eddie Benton, he was a trombone player. Worked at Whirlines before. I didn't know him. A little probably didn't know him.

Will an aide go to room two, please. Room two for an aide, please. I think that just about after Morrison's and the slipper, and the nut club and the Ladoo, that's where he dropped out of music. That's where he dropped out at that time. Long enough to settle down so I could go to school. We were in the ground and we were changing schools. It didn't break, so he stayed together.
